description: Defines a Storage API for long-term blob storage, including functions for opening, closing, reading, writing, and deleting storage records. It manages a single storage record handle and provides thread-unsafe, blocking I/O operations.

methods.name: SbStorageIsValidRecord
methods.description: Checks if a storage record handle is valid (not null).

methods.name: SbStorageOpenRecord
methods.description: Opens and returns a storage record by name or user (depending on API version).

methods.name: SbStorageCloseRecord
methods.description: Closes a storage record, ensuring data is flushed.

methods.name: SbStorageGetRecordSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the storage record.

methods.name: SbStorageReadRecord
methods.description: Reads data from the storage record into a buffer.

methods.name: SbStorageWriteRecord
methods.description: Writes data to the storage record, replacing existing data.

methods.name: SbStorageDeleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a storage record by name or user (depending on API version).
